artist_profiles.eligibility: All members required. If any member has original raw zero_norm or out_of_support, profile vector and position are null and both reasons are unsupported_member. Retain member IDs and exact original reasons. no_eligible_components is not an invalid vector.
artist_profiles.identity: Every member must share exactly one frozen component and fold; fail otherwise. All 53 artists retained.
artist_profiles.meaning: Available recording profile, not artist style. Singletons explicitly indicated; selected sample not representative.
artist_profiles.order: ascending native artist ID; member tracks ascending native track ID
artist_profiles.projection: Mean standardized vector @ saved PCA axes; no refit. If saved projection unusable position null with projection_degenerate. Zero mean norm <=1e-12 gives neighbor_reason zero_mean_norm but may retain valid projection.
artist_profiles.ranking: Candidates are fold0 artists with all members valid and mean norm>1e-12. Query invalid or zero mean abstains. Exclude entire query component. Sort cosine distance (1-dot(unitquery,unitcandidate)) ascending then native artist ID; greedy one artist per component, at most6. If none neighbor_reason no_eligible_components; projection unaffected.
artist_profiles.tag_evidence: Per native genre ID: exact member track IDs and track count; never predicted genres.
artist_profiles.vector: Equal-recording arithmetic mean of saved (features-center)/scale, inactive columns zero, using saved training-only normalization. Never average unit vectors.

inputs: Only the reviewed 55 candidate and frozen waveform52 pack; no refit, new audio, labels as acoustic inputs, or heldout tuning.

output.counts: Artist/track/genre totals, singleton artists; eligible training artist/component counts and per-profile eligible other candidate artist/component counts.
output.external_inputs: Validator requires candidate manifest and waveform pack; inventory binds protocol/declaration/discovery/receipt, receipt binds first3, discovery binds input hashes. No cycles.

source_cotags.edges: Unordered pairs of distinct direct genre IDs sharing at least one exact recording; no artist-union or component-union edges.
source_cotags.evidence: Shared track IDs, distinct artist IDs and frozen component IDs sorted numeric, with exact counts.
source_cotags.meaning: Observed shared source annotations; not taxonomy, probability, acoustic distance or musical relevance.
source_cotags.ordering: Genre rows ascending native ID; relationships shared track count descending then other genre ID.
source_cotags.scope: All55 already-visible catalog annotations; never training or evaluation inputs. All93 genre definitions retained including isolates.

validation: full component exclusion including ten artist component
zero mean has independent projection status
